name: actiongate-tavily-research-lab
summary: Optional public-documentation search and sandbox refund workflow with separate consumed permits; offline rehearsal and bounded live capture.
protects: The private Tavily credential and billable search handler, followed by a separate private sandbox refund handler.
bypass: Privileged host code can import or alter this in-process implementation; it is a local Guard, not network isolation.
Other clients using the same provider account are outside the local credit batch; this does not enforce account-wide billing.
Memory authorization state resets per workflow; the credit ledger blocks reuse but does not resume authorization after restart.
negativeTests: Changed actor refuses consumption before search; replay refuses a second consumption
Private queries, foreign domains, advanced depth and extra arguments fail before dispatch
Unknown billing, paid usage and insufficient free headroom fail before search
Unknown search cost retains reservation and closes the batch without retry
Source instructions cannot supply trusted ledger facts or raise the amount ceiling
The offline browser lab rejects cross-origin runs and never activates keys
